name: Horizontal Lifting / Plate Clamp
desc: ABLE SV Plus horizontal lifting clamp (HLC) for horizontal lifting and transfer of steel plates. A thin ground plate and buffer cams ease insertion and removal under the plate; the clamps can also hang vertically under a spreader. Forged jaw and cam in 20CrMnTi, minimum breaking load 500% of capacity, suitable for surface hardness up to 37 RC (345 HB). Meets BS EN 13155. WLL is rated per pair (0.75–3 t single).

specs.label: Type
specs.value: Horizontal plate lifting clamp (used in pairs)
